★ How to Bet on Betfair Exchange & Get Better Odds

The Betfair Exchange lets you take the Betfair Starting Price (BSP) — the true market price at race-off. This is ALWAYS better than the bookies by 10–50% in our experience. Here’s exactly how to do it.

1
Join Betfair
Go to betfair.com/exchange/plus and create a free account if you haven’t already.
2
Use the Exchange — NOT the Sportsbook
Once logged in, click Exchange at the top of the page — not Sportsbook. The Exchange is where BSP and real market prices live. The Sportsbook is just a regular bookmaker.
📝 Look for the two tabs: ExchangeSportsbook — always choose Exchange.
3
Find the Race & Choose Your Market
Navigate to today’s race. At the top of the market you’ll see several tabs — you need to pick the right one before clicking your horse:
Win — Your horse must win the race. Best liquidity, easiest to get BSP matched.
Top 2 / Top 3 / Top 4 Finishers — Place-only bets. Choose the tab that matches how many places the race pays. As a guide: 5–7 runners = 2 places, 8–15 runners = 3 places, 16+ runners = 4 places. Same odds 1000 / stake £1 / Take SP process as the Win bet — just a separate bet slip.
⚠️ Each Way tab — combines win + place in one bet but has very low liquidity on the Exchange. It’s harder to get BSP matched cleanly. We recommend doing two separate bets instead: one in the Win market and one in the Top 2/3/4 market. Same result, much better liquidity on both.
4
Click the Blue Cell Next to Your Horse
Once you’re in the right market tab, find your horse in the grid and click the blue cell next to its odds — this opens a bet slip on the right.
🔵 The blue cells are the Back prices (bet the horse to finish as selected). The pink cells are the Lay prices — ignore those.
5
Set Odds to 1000 & Stake to £1
In the bet slip you’ll see two boxes: Odds and Stake.
⚠️ Be careful! Set Odds = 1000 and Stake = £1. Do not mix them up — you do NOT want £1000 stake at odds of 1!
Your bet will show: Liability: £1.00 — you only ever risk £1.
6
Click “Place Bets”
Hit the yellow Place Bets button. Because 1000/1 won’t be matched by the market, it will appear under Unmatched Bets — this is exactly what we want. If betting Win + Place separately, repeat steps 3–6 for the place market now.
7
Select “Take SP” and click Update
In the Receipt / Unmatched Bets panel, select Take SP from the three radio options (Cancel / Keep / Take SP), then click the yellow Update button. Do this for each unmatched bet.
✅ Done! Your bet will be matched at Betfair Starting Price at race-off — automatically, with no further action needed.

💡 Why does this work?

By requesting 1000/1 the bet is never matched before the race. Selecting Take SP tells Betfair to match it at the Betfair Starting Price when the race goes off — a price calculated from real money in the market. BSP is ALWAYS better than the bookmakers, typically 10–50% better odds. Your liability is just £1, so there’s no risk of an accidental large bet. For Win + Place together, total liability is just £2. Our data shows this approach beats E/W on the Exchange for liquidity every time.

StepActionKey Detail
1Join Betfairbetfair.com/exchange/plus
2Choose ExchangeNOT Sportsbook
3Choose Market tabWin  |  Top 2/3/4 (place)  |  avoid Each Way tab (low liquidity)
4Click blue cellOpens bet slip for that horse
5Set odds & stakeOdds = 1000  |  Stake = £1
6Place BetsShows as Unmatched — repeat for place market if doing Win+Place
7Take SP → UpdateBSP at race-off — 10–50% better than bookies
